### Purpose
Customer interaction tracking and relationship management.
name: Chunk 46/57

raw_entities.name: Customer Interaction Tracking
raw_entities.description: A customer-facing guidance item explaining how the bank tracks and manages customer interactions as part of relationship management processes. This covers the operational procedures and customer expectations around interaction documentation and record-keeping.
context: Customer interaction tracking and relationship management

raw_entities.name: Relationship Management
raw_entities.description: A customer-facing guidance item describing how the bank manages ongoing customer relationships, including the processes and touchpoints through which customers interact with the bank and how their relationship is maintained over time.
context: Customer interaction tracking and relationship management
